heading: NP Prescribing Notes
title: - NPs can submit Special Authority requests, including by eForm from private community practice. NP prescribing limits and conditions are set by [BCCNM - Nurse Practitioners: Prescribing Drugs](https://www.bccnm.ca/NP/PracticeStandards/Pages/Prescribing.aspx); PharmaNet and PRIME are on [Practice: Prescribing Authority](../6%20Practice/Prescribing%20Authority.md).

heading: NP Prescribing Notes
title: - Ontario NPs submit Exceptional Access Program requests through [SADIE](https://www.ontario.ca/page/sadie-special-authorization-digital-information-exchange); ODB pays for drugs on the e-Formulary and, with the Limited Use code, for Limited Use drugs — *[EAP](https://www.ontario.ca/page/exceptional-access-program)*
